method: Human adjudication (the ops person behind the agent) of each sampled row against (a) fetched official docs text from pipeline/verify.py, (b) targeted cross-examination web searches from official domains, (c) live MCP endpoint probes. Apps whose docs cannot be observed at all are excluded from scoring rather than rubber-stamped.

scoring_rules.unit: field-level exact match: auth, access, api_surface, mcp, verdict
scoring_rules.synonym_collapse: auth/api_surface sets compared after collapsing {API key, Token} -> static-key and {JWT, JWT key-pair} -> jwt. Scheme families (OAuth2, Basic, HMAC, OAuth1) never collapse.
scoring_rules.over_list_penalty: Listing a credential-inside-a-scheme as a separate method (e.g. 'API key' AND 'Basic' where the key is the Basic password) is an over-listing miss. Claiming a family that does not exist (phantom OAuth2) is a miss.

unscorable.84: Paygent Connect: no developer docs exist on the public web (it is an NMI white-label reseller). Nothing to adjudicate against — reported as 'app defeated the agent' rather than scored.
